Inge Mølgaard is a patient representative involved in the governance of cardiovascular health data and quality development in Denmark. Specifically, she serves as a patient representative for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database) [^src1]. In this capacity, she is a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] (AFDK Steering Committee) [^src2], where she formally acts as a patient representative [^src3]. 

Her ongoing involvement in the database's governance is documented across multiple annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, spanning the 2023 [^src1], 2024 [^src2], and 2025 [^src3] reporting periods. Her role underscores the multidisciplinary and cross-sectoral nature of the AFDK steering committee, ensuring that patient perspectives are integrated into the clinical quality development, data validation, and decision-making processes for atrial fibrillation treatment in Denmark.
